headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 1, 2026**
article:
The Orioles dominated the White Sox in a 6-1 victory, with Sam Antonacci leading the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run. Noah Schultz pitched 4.1 innings with 7 strikeouts for the White Sox. In other action, the Guardians secured a 9-4 win over the Rangers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Austin Hedges led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs. The Nationals routed the Red Sox 10-2, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Matt Chapman, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants due to an abdominal strain. Other injured players include Kris Bubic (Kansas City Royals, left elbow soreness), Connor Seabold (Kansas City Royals, right lat strain), Corey Seager (Texas Rangers, lower back inflammation), Will Vest (Detroit Tigers, right posterior elbow inflammation), Connelly Early (Boston Red Sox, left elbow inflammation), Anthony Bender (Miami Marlins, right shin stress reaction), and Jeremy Peña (Houston Astros, left calf strain).

There were several notable trades and roster moves, including the Baltimore Orioles trading RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Washington Nationals for SS Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen, while the Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The San Francisco Giants traded 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners for cash.

top_news.title: **Orioles Dominate White Sox in 6-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a decisive win over the Chicago White Sox, finishing with a 6-1 final score. Sam Antonacci led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Noah Schultz pitched 4.1 innings with 7 strikeouts for the White Sox.

top_news.title: **Rangers Fall to Guardians in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Austin Hedges led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Keider Montero earning the win. Kevin McGonigle led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Phillies 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with several players making significant contributions to the win. Impact hitters for the Pirates included Jake Mangum, Brandon Lowe, Esmerlyn Valdez, Nick Gonzales, and Endy Rodríguez, while Jared Jones stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Matt Chapman on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. The move was made on July 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.
